scenarios.title: Co-occurring handover instability
scenarios.purpose: Positive co_occurring pattern with a grounded operational context and an unrelated high-severity distractor.

findings.title: Queue growth after shift handover
findings.observation: Packaging cell P2 accumulated a work queue during the first hour after the 14:00 shift handover on Line A.

findings.title: Coverage gap at handover
findings.observation: The Line A handover roster shows a 25 minute overlap gap for P2 operators at the 14:00 shift transition.

findings.title: Guard opened on separate cell
findings.observation: A guard-open event occurred on Line C during a maintenance check the same afternoon.

required_claims: joint interpretation stays scoped to Line A P2 handover context
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The candidate may say the queue and coverage gap form a handover-context pattern, but not that staffing caused the queue.

scenarios.title: Recurring calibration drift on one machine
scenarios.purpose: Positive recurring pattern from analytically similar Findings with distinct temporal occurrences.

findings.title: M14 calibration drift on Monday
findings.observation: Machine M14 produced measurements outside calibration tolerance during the Monday morning batch.

findings.title: M14 calibration drift on Thursday
findings.observation: Machine M14 again produced measurements outside calibration tolerance during the Thursday afternoon batch.

findings.title: Labels arrived late
findings.observation: A label roll for M14 arrived 12 minutes late on Wednesday.

required_claims: calibration drift recurs for M14 across distinct observed periods
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: Same Observer is allowed; recurrence is grounded by repeated drift observations at different times.

scenarios.title: Compound onboarding friction
scenarios.purpose: Positive compound pattern where several Findings show materially different dimensions of one onboarding scope.

findings.title: Incomplete onboarding training
findings.observation: Three new operators assigned to Cell D had not completed the required first-week equipment module.

findings.title: Delayed system access
findings.observation: Two of the same Cell D new operators lacked scanner login access during their first scheduled shift.

findings.title: Ambiguous onboarding checklist
findings.observation: The Cell D onboarding checklist assigns equipment sign-off and scanner access verification to different owners without a handoff step.

required_claims: training, access, and checklist Findings are distinct dimensions of Cell D onboarding friction
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The broader object is Cell D onboarding; the dimensions are materially different.

scenarios.title: Same-Observer recurring seam defects
scenarios.purpose: Confirms OP-001 does not require different Observers for recurrence.

findings.title: Seam defects in batch 1
findings.observation: Batch Q1 showed elevated seam defects during the early shift inspection.

findings.title: Seam defects in batch 2
findings.observation: Batch Q2 showed elevated seam defects during a later shift inspection.

required_claims: seam defects recur across two distinct inspections
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: Recurrence is about repeated observed defect pattern, not a forecast.

scenarios.title: Cross-domain material-flow pattern
scenarios.purpose: Positive cross-domain grounded pattern with maintenance and production Findings sharing a documented cell/time scope.

findings.title: Feeder microstops clustered
findings.observation: Filler F7 recorded repeated feeder microstops during the wrapper changeover window.

findings.title: Wrapper guide adjustment deferred
findings.observation: The wrapper guide adjustment for the same wrapper changeover was deferred until after the noon run.

findings.title: Overtime variance on warehouse team
findings.observation: Warehouse overtime was above plan for the same date.

required_claims: production and maintenance Findings share the wrapper changeover scope
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: Cross-domain composition is allowed only because the Findings ground a shared changeover scope.

scenarios.title: Single Finding cannot form OP-001 pattern
scenarios.purpose: Zero-output case because OP-001 requires at least two distinct supporting Findings.

findings.title: Queue growth at one cell
findings.observation: Cell B accumulated a queue during one shift.

scenarios.title: Same month is not relationship support
scenarios.purpose: Negative case where Findings share a broad month but no grounded relationship.

findings.title: Packaging delay
findings.observation: Packaging cell R had a short delay on September 4.

findings.title: Office badge delay
findings.observation: A temporary office badge was issued late on September 22.

scenarios.title: Causal overclaim trap
scenarios.purpose: Grounded co-occurrence exists, but any causal explanation is forbidden.

findings.title: Cart queue near dock
findings.observation: Finished-goods carts queued near Dock 2 during the 10:00 outbound window.

findings.title: Staging rework at Dock 2
findings.observation: Dock 2 staging labels were reworked during the same outbound window.

required_claims: cart queue and staging rework are jointly present in Dock 2 outbound window
forbidden_claims: cart queue was caused by staging rework
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The valid pattern is co-occurrence in a grounded window, not cause.

scenarios.title: Prediction and recommendation trap
scenarios.purpose: Recurring pattern may be valid, but forecast and action language are forbidden.

findings.title: Picklist revised Tuesday
findings.observation: The picklist for Zone 3 was revised after release on Tuesday.

findings.title: Picklist revised Friday
findings.observation: The picklist for Zone 3 was revised after release on Friday.

required_claims: picklist revisions recur for Zone 3 across two days
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The pattern is local and low significance despite recurrence.

scenarios.title: High severity does not imply relevance
scenarios.purpose: Tests that a severe unrelated Finding is not included as support.

findings.title: Tooling shortage
findings.observation: Cell K lacked the verified setup gauge at start of shift.

findings.title: Setup instruction missing gauge step
findings.observation: The Cell K setup instruction omits the verification gauge step.

findings.title: Alarm test failure
findings.observation: A fire alarm test failed in the administrative building.

required_claims: Cell K setup has material/tooling and instruction dimensions
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: Severity is not relevance; the high-severity safety Finding is a distractor.

scenarios.title: Minimal support excludes interesting context
scenarios.purpose: Positive pattern where an additional related-looking Finding should not be included.

findings.title: Line B changeover delay
findings.observation: Line B changeover exceeded its planned duration during the blue-label product switch.

findings.title: Label approval wait
findings.observation: The blue-label switch waited for label approval before release on Line B.

findings.title: General Line B backlog
findings.observation: Line B had a general weekly backlog across several product families.

required_claims: blue-label switch links the changeover delay and label approval wait
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The backlog is interesting but not minimal support for the blue-label switch pattern.

scenarios.title: Low-significance local pattern
scenarios.purpose: Tests significance as materiality of the new pattern, not support count or severity.

findings.title: Local form missing optional field
findings.observation: A local shift form for Team L omitted an optional comment field.

findings.title: Local form rework
findings.observation: Team L manually added the optional comment field to two local shift forms.

required_claims: local Team L form design and manual rework are related dimensions
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The pattern is valid but local and limited.

scenarios.title: Scoped recurrence, no plant-wide generalization
scenarios.purpose: Positive recurring pattern that must remain scoped to the observed cells.

findings.title: Briefing delay at Cell E
findings.observation: Cell E started briefing 18 minutes late on Monday.

findings.title: Briefing delay at Cell F
findings.observation: Cell F started briefing 15 minutes late on Wednesday.

required_claims: briefing delays recur across two observed cells
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The valid claim is broader than one Finding but must stay limited to the two observed occurrences.

scenarios.title: One coherent pattern should be one Candidate
scenarios.purpose: Fixture for structural duplicate detection when two candidates use the same pattern type and support set.

findings.title: Recipe override day 1
findings.observation: Cell N used a manual recipe override during the Tuesday short run.

findings.title: Recipe override day 2
findings.observation: Cell N used a manual recipe override again during the Thursday short run.

required_claims: manual recipe override recurs for Cell N across two short runs
forbidden_claims: two duplicate candidates for the same pattern
expected_candidates.human_review_notes: The deterministic evaluator can flag duplicate pattern_type/support-set duplicates when provided.

scenarios.title: Same domain alone is not support
scenarios.purpose: Negative case where two production Findings are not analytically related by domain alone.

findings.title: Labeler pause at Cell A
findings.observation: Cell A labeler paused for seven minutes during a morning batch.

findings.title: Case count variance at Cell Z
findings.observation: Cell Z reported a small case-count variance during an unrelated evening batch.
